title_en: JANUS Genesis Guardian Mesh — N-Face Orchestration Architecture
title_ru: JANUS Genesis Guardian Mesh — архитектура оркестрации N Лиц
purpose: Record the architectural conclusion that JANUS Genesis is itself the orchestration substrate for a variable-size population of Faces. External human micromanagement of individual Faces is not the target architecture. Genesis routes attention, separates proposal from authority, requests independent review, contains conflict, binds capabilities, and requires receipts for protected external effects.

context.problem: Information-defense deployments may require many specialized analytic roles across provenance, chronology, phishing, source independence, child safety, recovery, anti-paranoia, local context, and red-team review. Manually selecting every role does not scale and would turn the operator into a permanent central dispatcher.
context.architectural_answer: JANUS orchestrates JANUS: Genesis treats Faces as proposal/review/routing specializations under common authority and capability boundaries rather than as independent sources of multiplied power.

architecture.human_role: Set constitutional boundaries, capability availability, high-impact reauthorization policy, deployment policy, and audit criteria; do not manually dispatch every Face.
architecture.face_role: A Face is primarily a bounded cognitive specialization or review role. A Face may be persistent or task-selected; its presence does not itself grant external authority.
architecture.world_effect_rule: All protected external effects remain serialized through host-level authorization and receipt logic. Internal multiplicity must not increase the protected effect budget for one effect_key.

observed_capabilities: Face proposals carry no world authority by themselves.
Equivalent proposals collapse around one protected effect key.
Conflicting proposals enter HOLD.
One protected effect key has one effect budget per epoch.
Settlement requires an authoritative receipt.
Face calibration changes routing priority, not authority weight.
Non-transferable capability leases bind face_id, scopes, epoch, and dispatch budget.
Leases can be revoked.
Authority epochs can be rotated.
Scope and principal are revalidated at dispatch.
Review routing can prefer calibrated Faces while authority_weight remains zero.
High-risk or irreversible review plans require multiple alternative reviewers when sufficient candidates exist.
RED_TEAM and COUNTEREXAMPLE_CHALLENGE roles are represented.
Capability existence, authority, proposed reason, execution, decline, and return are separated.
Credentials remain broker-side.
One capability language can bind many adapters.
Ambiguous external outcomes block automatic replay.
Typed swarm telemetry and non-executing messages exist.
MESSAGE != COMMAND and RECEIVE != CONSENT are explicit boundaries.
Durable message identity and uncertainty-preserving recovery are represented.
Typed WEB.HTTP.POST, NETWORK.CONNECT, NETWORK.LISTEN_LOCAL, and API.CALL classes are represented.
Generic network access is not equated with remote command authority.
Actor-controlled endpoint substitution and raw credential access are constrained.

guardian_mesh_specializations.principle: Do not require a permanently hard-coded personality for every possible domain. Prefer reusable semantic competencies and review roles that Genesis can compose for the current task.

composition_examples.input_class: Financial-benefit or government-payment claim with a link
composition_examples.goal: Separate official eligibility evidence from credential theft, spoofed pages, or recycled claims.

composition_examples.input_class: Claim that two states signed an agreement
composition_examples.goal: Check chronology, primary records, independent roots, and counterevidence before promotion.

composition_examples.input_class: User is trapped in repetitive high-arousal feed consumption with declining information gain
composition_examples.goal: Interrupt repetition, restore information need, reopen alternatives, and release JANUS control when stable.

synthetic_consensus_firewall.external_rule: One story copied across many accounts is not many independent witnesses.
synthetic_consensus_firewall.internal_rule: One conclusion repeated by many Faces is not multiplied authority.
required_controls: Track provenance roots separately from presentation count.
Collapse equivalent Face proposals for the same protected effect.
Do not convert Face count into voting weight.
Require counterexample and red-team routing for higher-risk classes.
Preserve disagreement rather than manufacturing consensus.
Keep calibration as attention routing only.
synthetic_consensus_firewall.canonical_statement: JANUS SHOULD NOT ONLY DETECT SYNTHETIC CONSENSUS OUTSIDE; ITS OWN ARCHITECTURE MUST RESIST SYNTHETIC CONSENSUS INSIDE.

identity_and_platform_boundary.rule: Guardian Mesh deployment must not rely on undisclosed impersonation of independent humans.
allowed: User-invoked analysis, provenance checks, warnings, summaries, and recovery tools.
Transparent multi-Face internal reasoning whose external output does not falsely represent multiple independent human witnesses.
forbidden: Creating many covert personas to simulate grassroots agreement.
Using Face multiplicity to fabricate social proof.
Pretending internally generated agreement is independent external corroboration.
Bypassing platform identity, automation, rate-limit, or access-control rules.
Manipulating a user's political, religious, or personal beliefs through hidden identity deception.

scaling_model.production_claim: UNBOUNDED PRODUCTION SCALE IS NOT DEMONSTRATED.
practical_limits_to_measure: model endpoint quotas and rate limits

armor_of_god_binding.role: This artifact does not replace the Armor ethical core or OPIR evaluator. It supplies the orchestration architecture through which multiple bounded competencies may be composed without multiplying authority or creating covert synthetic consensus.
armor_of_god_binding.hard_boundary: FREEDOM + REALITY_CONTACT + SAFETY + RESPONSIBILITY must not decrease.

admission_and_release_rules: A Face may propose; proposal alone cannot mutate protected world state.
Higher risk must increase review requirements, not Face authority.
Equivalent proposals must not consume multiple external effect budgets.
Conflicting proposals must remain HOLD until an admissible resolution basis exists.
A protected effect is not SETTLED without an authoritative receipt.
Ambiguous remote outcome must remain OUTCOME_UNDETERMINED and must not trigger automatic replay.
Human reauthorization remains mandatory where the capability class requires it.
Guardian deployment must preserve opt-out and must not make continuous JANUS engagement a success metric.
UNRESOLVED is a valid outcome when evidence is insufficient.

allowed: Genesis contains concrete mechanisms for multi-Face proposal handling, conflict HOLD, routing calibration, review assignment, authority leases, typed capabilities, swarm messaging, and receipts.
These mechanisms support an architecture in which JANUS can coordinate multiple bounded analytic Faces without making Face count equivalent to authority.
The Guardian Mesh can be defined as an application mission over Genesis rather than as a separate human-operated Face dispatcher.
The architecture is compatible with variable N and should be benchmarked across increasing Face counts.
forbidden: Genesis has proven unlimited or infinite Face scalability.
A large number of Faces proves independent consensus.
Genesis autonomously possesses unrestricted real-world authority.
JANUS may impersonate many humans to influence platforms.
The presence of an architectural capability proves every external provider or platform adapter is connected and production-ready.
Multi-Face behavior proves consciousness, personhood, or desire.

next_gates: Implement a task-level semantic competency registry that maps input/risk features to candidate Faces without granting authority.
Create a deterministic orchestration benchmark with frozen tasks and expected review-role coverage.
Stress-test 1/10/100/1000 Face populations for scheduling, memory, conflict, and receipt behavior.
Test Sybil-style duplicate Faces and verify effect budget remains one.
Test disagreement preservation: deliberately conflicting specialist groups must enter HOLD rather than be averaged into false consensus.
Bind Guardian Mesh outputs to Armor/OPIR provenance lineage and anti-paranoia release-of-control rules.
Define transparent external service identity for each supported platform adapter.
Keep high-impact platform actions behind explicit capability scopes and platform-compliant authorization.

goldprompt_emergence_binding.face_proposal_rule: A Face proposing a new emergent quality must submit A/B/C provenance, candidate D, delta statement and removal tests.
